messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been decent up there. Can you share your blood pressure reading for today?
178 over 104. Also been having a dull headache behind my eyes most of the afternoon.

Thanks for telling me. That reading is outside your target range, and with the headache I want to make sure a nurse hears about this today. I've flagged it for the care team — they're showing a median response time of 31 hours right now. If things feel significantly worse before then, please call 911 or head to the ER. Anything else you want me to pass along to the nurse?
Yeah — should I take an extra lisinopril to bring it down? And I'm out of refills.

Advising on medication changes isn't something I'm able to do — that's clinical guidance, and the nurse is the right person to answer that. I've added it to the notes so she has the full picture when she reaches out. On refills, that's outside what I can help with right now; your best bet is calling your pharmacy or the clinic directly.
Alright, thanks for passing it along.
Of course. Your next regular check-in is in 7 days, but don't wait on that if anything changes. Take care of yourself.

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
